Claim 1 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least [one or more] bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptides.

Claim 2 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo.

Claim 3 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product.

Claim 4 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes.

Claim 10 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from at least two different BMC operons.

Claim 12 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and produce a non-native compartment that comprises a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide.

Claim 21 (currently amended): (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product wherein the product is selected from the group consisting of bioactive products, drugs, drug precursors, biofuels, and products in metabolic pathways.
